description: Generic BIP LOV fragment. Calls a BI Publisher report via bipService (SOAP), parses the XML response, and renders a dropdown. Pass xdoPath, idField, labelField, and optional reportParameters. Returns selectedKey and selectedItem via writeback.

bipEndpoint.description: VB service endpoint for the BIP SOAP call. Defaults to the shared generic runner bipService/runBIPReport.

xdoPath.description: Absolute path of the BIP .xdo report, e.g. /Custom/PWP/PWP_Redesign/EQP_CONTRACTS_BY_PROJECT_LOV_RP.xdo

reportParameters.description: Optional array of {name, value} objects for BIP report parameters, e.g. [{name:'P_PROJECT_ID', value:'300000308147872'}]. Changing this array triggers an automatic reload.

rowTag.description: XML element name for each data row in the report output. Defaults to G_1 (standard BIP row tag).

idField.description: XML element name whose text content becomes the item key, e.g. CONTRACT_ID

labelField.description: XML element name to use as the primary display label, e.g. CONTRACT_NUMBER

label2Field.description: Optional XML element name shown as secondary label below the primary, e.g. STATUS

cascadeTargetVariable.description: Name of a boolean page variable to toggle (false→true) when this LOV's value changes, causing a dependent LOV to remount. Leave empty if no cascade needed.

selectedKey.description: Two-way: the key of the currently selected item (value of idField)

selectedItem.description: Writeback: full row object with all XML fields flattened plus id/label/label2 aliases
